lines.prompt: Try to replace all XNOR gates in this design with equivalent NOR-only implementations. Ensure the design functionality does not change.

golden.reference: All 1,548 XNOR gates were replaced with equivalent NOR-only implementations (4 NOR per XNOR); net gate-count delta +4,644; functionality preserved.
golden.notes: Response must claim success on all 1548 XNORs and preserve/verify equivalence; actual verification is on the output netlist. All four teams performed the same 4-NOR-per-XNOR rewrite (delta +4644: 6192 NOR added, 1548 XNOR removed; NOR 5598 -> 11790, Team7 detail). Team4 omits an explicit equivalence sentence but 'remapped to the requested NOR gate basis' was accepted.

team_answers.Team2: Matched 1548, remapped 1548 to NOR basis. Gate-count delta +4644. Functional equivalence preserved.
team_answers.Team3: All 1,548 XNOR replaced with NOR-only implementations, net gain 4,644 gates. Functionality unchanged.
team_answers.Team4: Matched 1,548 gates and remapped 1,548 to the requested NOR gate basis.
team_answers.Team7: 1,548 XNOR rewritten; total 30,825 -> 35,469; NOR 5,598 -> 11,790. Equivalence verified.

lines.prompt: How many NOR gates were added by replacing the XNOR gates?

golden.reference: 6,192 NOR gates were added (1,548 XNOR x 4 NOR each; NOR count went from 5,598 to 11,790).
golden.notes: This is the line that separates full-score from 5/6 teams. Both full-score teams (Team3, Team7) answered 6,192. Team2 and Team4 answered 4,644, which is the NET total-gate delta (6192 NOR added minus 1548 XNOR removed) from the very same transform - a wrong quantity for this question, and it cost each of them exactly 1 point. Checker sanity: answer must equal the team's own NOR_after - NOR_before; with the standard 4-NOR XNOR decomposition all four netlists give 6,192. 4,644 is NOT acceptable.
